Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
 Order

31.05.2023 Petitioner's grievance which has brought him to the present writ petition is that despite being the owner held entitled to land compensation in terms of the award no. SDM/G/Rly/57-64 dated 15.05.2018 passed by the respondent no. 3 - the Collector Land Acquisition (SDM), Gool district Ramban, not even a penny of compensation amount has still been paid to the petitioner who is a senior citizen and is filing this writ petition through his son, namely, Chuni Lal.

Mrs. Monika Kohli, learned Sr. AAG accepts notice on behalf of the respondents and is directed to submit a status report with regard to the compensation status in terms of the award vis--vis the petitioner.
Let the requisite status report be furnished by the respondent no. 3 - the Collector Land Acquisition (SDM), Gool district Ramban within a period of three weeks.
